meaning: From no premises: the motion route to act's simple priority (Codex lead on #374) is valid with exactly five premises, each needed: STMT-EVERY-POTENCY-IS-BEING-ACTUALIZED (unattributed), STMT-NOTHING-REDUCED-TO-ACT-EXCEPT-BY-A-MOVER, STMT-NOTHING-MOVES-EXCEPT-AS-IN-ACT, STMT-NOTHING-IN-ACT-AND-POTENCY-IN-SAME-RESPECT and STMT-ACTUAL-MOVER-IS-SIMPLY-PRIOR (unattributed). The first is load-bearing exactly where ST I q.3 a.1 uses act's priority: without it the route gives priority only for potencies being actualized, which allows a first mover moved by none and first being to be in potency (in a model that also satisfies every prima via premise and STMT-SOME-POTENCY-NOT-BEING-ACTUALIZED). The first premise contradicts STMT-SOME-POTENCY-NOT-BEING-ACTUALIZED (unattributed) and, read as holding in every situation, STMT-POTENCY-CAN-BE-INACTIVE, which Physics III.1, 201b8-9 states; read of the present situation alone, no source decides it. The route is therefore not recorded as an argument for STMT-ACT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-TO-POTENCY: it would add two bare premises to the root paths, the first unsupported and denied by the source as a law, and close nothing. Discharges nothing.
